reason: I grab a Monster at the petrol station or Albert on the way to work, and this isn't there, it's an e-shop or some café. At 55 CZK for less caffeine than my usual can, I don't see why I'd go out of my way.
objection: 80 mg is less than my Monster, so I'm not sure I'd even feel it, and I'd be paying more for it.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in the fridge at Albert or Tesco next to Red Bull for around 40 CZK, so I could try one on impulse.
